questions.question: The sum of the cost price of A and B is Rs. 1200. The sum of the selling prices of A and B is Rs. 1390. If the profits earned on A and B are 10% and 20% respectively, then what is the ratio of the cost prices of A and B?
questions.solution:
Let the cost price of A be x

⇒ The cost price of B = 1200 - x

⇒ x × 110% + (1200 - x) × 120% = 1390

⇒ 1440 - 10x % = 1390

⇒ 10x% = 50

⇒ x = 500

⇒ Cost price of A = x = Rs. 500

⇒ Cost price of B = 1200 - x = Rs. 700

⇒ Cost price of A : Cost price of B = 500 : 700 = 5 : 7

∴ The ratio of the cost prices of A and B is 5 : 7

questions.question: The height and radius of the right circular cone is 4 cm and 3 cm respectively. What is the total surface area of the cone?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

 Height = 4 cm and radius = 3 cm

**Calculation:**

Slant height (l) = √(r² + h²) = √(16 + 9) = 5 cm

The total surface area of the cone = πrl + πr² = πr(l + r)

The total surface area of the cone = π × 3 × (5 + 3) = 24π cm²

**∴ The total surface area of the cone is 24π cm².**

questions.question: If the lateral surface area of the cube is 144 cm², then what is the length of its side?
questions.solution:
**Concept used:**

The lateral surface area of the cube = 4 × (side)²

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

⇒ 4 × (side)² = 144

⇒ Side = √36 = 6 cm

**∴ The side of the cube is 6 cm.**

questions.question: The marked price of an article is 7/5 of the cost price. If discount of 20% is given on the marked price, then what is the profit percentage?
questions.solution:
Let the cost price be 5x

⇒ Marked price = 7x

⇒ Selling price = marked price × (100 - discount)%

⇒ Selling price = 7x × (100 - 20)% = 7x × 80% = 5.6x

⇒ The profit percentage = [(5.6x - 5x)/5x] × 100 = [0.6/5] × 100 = 12%

∴ The profit percentage is 12%

questions.question: The average weight of 13 students and their teacher is 24.5 kg. If the weight of the teacher is 31 kg. Then what is the average weight of the 13 students?
questions.solution:
The average weight of 13 students and their teacher = 24.5 kg

⇒ Total weight of 13 students and their teacher = 24.5 × (13 + 1) = 343 kg

⇒ Total weight of 13 students + Weight of teacher = 343

⇒ Total weight of 13 students + 31 = 343

⇒ Total weight of 13 students = 312 kg

⇒ Average weight of 13 students = 312/13 = 24 kg

∴ The average weight of 13 students is 24 kg.

questions.question: A sum is invested at a simple interest. If the rate of interest is 20% per annum, then in how much time will it become double of itself?
questions.solution:
Let the amount be p

⇒ Than simple interest = p

⇒ S.I. = PRT/100

⇒ p = [p × 20 × T]/100

⇒ 1 = T/5

⇒ T = 5 years

∴ It becomes double of itself in 5 years.

questions.question: Aditya can complete a work in 24 alone. Raman can complete the same work in 45 days alone. In how many days can they together complete the work?
questions.solution:
Together complete the work = (d₁ × d₂)/(d₁ + d₂)

⇒ Together complete the work = (24 × 45)/69 = 360/23

∴ Together Aditya and Raman can complete the work is 360/23 days.

The average of a and b is 10, an average of b and c is 12 and an average of c and a is 15. What is the average of a, b and c?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Sum of the averages of pairs = 10 + 12 + 15 = 37.

In pair averages, each variable (a, b, c) is counted twice in the sum of totals.

Total sum (a + b + c) = Sum of averages of pairs = 37.

Average of a, b, and c = (Sum of a, b, c) ÷ 3 = 37/3.

**∴ The correct answer is 37/3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average of a and b = 10

Average of b and c = 12

Average of c and a = 15

**Formula:** Average = Sum of observations ÷ Number of observations

 
 a + b = 20
 
 b + c = 24
 
 c + a = 30
 
• 
 Add all equations:
 2(a + b + c) = 20 + 24 + 30
 2(a + b + c) = 74

⇒ Sum of a and b (a + b) = 10 × 2 = 20

⇒ Sum of b and c (b + c) = 12 × 2 = 24

⇒ Sum of c and a (c + a) = 15 × 2 = 30

⇒ Adding all three: (a + b) + (b + c) + (c + a) = 20 + 24 + 30

⇒ 2a + 2b + 2c = 74

⇒ 2(a + b + c) = 74

⇒ a + b + c = 74 ÷ 2 = 37

⇒ Average of a, b, and c = (a + b + c) ÷ 3 = 37/3

**∴ The correct answer is 37/3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average

When groups have different numbers of elements, the combined average is [ (n₁ × Avg₁) + (n₂ × Avg₂) ] ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

Sum of Observations

The total sum of a data set is always equal to the Average × Number of observations.

Average of Symmetric Pairs

If averages of (a,b), (b,c), and (c,a) are given, the average of (a,b,c) is always (Sum of pair averages) ÷ 3.</p

questions.question: Speed of a car is 20 m/s. How much distance (in km) will the car travel in 2.5 hours?
questions.solution:
Speed of a car = 20 × 18/5 = 72 km/hour

⇒ In 1 hour = 72 km

⇒ In 2.5 hours = 72 × 2.5 = 180 km

∴ The car will travel 180 km in 2.5 hours.

questions.question: Rs 3600 becomes Rs. 4900 in 2 years when kept at compound interest (compounded annually). What is the rate of interest per annum?
questions.solution:
Given, principal (P) = Rs. 3600, time (t) = 2 years

Amount (A) = Rs. 4900

A = P(1 + r/100)t

⇒ 4900/3600 = (1 + r/100)²

⇒ (1 + r/100) = 7/6

⇒ r/100 = 1/6

Rightarrow {{ r }} = 16(2)/(3)\% 

therefore {{ The rate of interest per annum is }}16(2)/(3)\%

questions.question: The ratio between the two given numbers is 9 : 7 If each number is increased by 6, then the ratio becomes 21 : 17. What is the difference between the two given numbers?
questions.solution:
Let the first number be 9x and the second number be 7x

Rightarrow frac{{9x + 6}}{{7x + 6}} = frac{{21}}{{17}}

⇒ 153x + 102 = 147x + 126

⇒ 6x = 24

⇒ x = 4

⇒ Difference between two numbers = 9x - 7x = 2x = 8

⇒ Difference between two numbers is 8.

questions.question: The expenses incurred by department D1 is approximately what percent of the expenses incurred by department D6?
questions.solution:

⇒ The expenses incurred by department D6 = 12%

⇒ Required % = (19/12) × 100 = 158.33%
